text:
maria (Docs): Quick thread for PR 4389 (relnotes + embed streaming examples). Need: tighten bullets, confirm known-issues wording, and fix the JS streaming snippet which now emits a metadata header.

kevin: I'll take the JS snippet. Current loop assumes payload-only; new behavior streams an initial meta chunk. I'll add `if (chunk.type === 'meta') continue;` and a short comment.

tara: I'll handle the migration blurb from /embeds -> /embed-streaming. Keep it short and PM-friendly. Draft: 'Switch /embeds requests to /embed-streaming for live streaming; minimal request-path update only. See migration guide for examples.' Thoughts?

maria (Docs): Good start. Change 'minimal' -> 'small' and add 'No model changes required.'

tara: Edited: 'Switch /embeds requests to /embed-streaming for live streaming; most clients need a small change to the request path; no model changes required. See migration guide for examples and compatibility table.'

infra-bot: compatibility-matrix.csv uploaded to PR artifacts.

kevin: Found two doc micro-issues: a broken /docs/api#embeddings anchor and a Go snippet calling deprecated `client.Embeds()`. Will push fixes with messages: 'fix: embeddings anchor' and 'fix: go sdk rename'.

docs-bot: linkcheck running on pr/4389...

kevin: Pushed snippet + go rename + anchor fix.

docs-bot: linkcheck completed. 1 broken link found (internal S3 benchmark).

maria (Docs): Replace that with the public benchmark URL and we can merge. Can we aim to merge today? Need relnotes live tomorrow AM.

kevin: Replaced link and pushed. Ready for review.

docs-bot: PR 4389 reviewers approved: tara, kevin. Merged by kevin.

maria (Docs): Thanks team. Scheduling relnotes publish for 07:00 UTC tomorrow. Please watch for any formatting glitches post-publish.

tara: Will monitor and fix as needed.

maria (Docs): Summary: kevin: snippet + go rename + anchor (done), tara: migration blurb (done), infra-bot: compat CSV (done). :thumbsup:
